_methodology.purpose: Captures the pre-recovery values produced by `_default_health_probe` in akosha/mcp/server.py for the local_traces_feed block. Used as a parity baseline so Phase 3 of the akosha OTel feed recovery plan can verify the post-change payload structurally (REQ-005).
_methodology.pre_change_formula: local_traces_ok = (local_traces_count > 0 or not any_producer_ever_cycled or not any_producer_alive)
_methodology.inputs_synthesis: Each case documents the module-level global state (_otel_trace_ingester, _kg_refresh_task, _kg_refresh_cycles, _kg_refresh_errors, hot_store contents) that would produce the listed payload. The probe is a lifespan closure that cannot be invoked directly without spinning up the full server, so each payload was hand-derived by walking the exact pre-change code path with the listed inputs.
_methodology.bug_under_test: Case A (otel running, empty feed) currently reports ok=False even though the producer is alive and merely has not received spans yet. This violates the wire-up contract's intent (a running-but-empty feed should be tolerated as 'warming up' rather than degraded) and breaks Phase 3 REQ-005.
expected_post_change: Case A: ok flips to True (the producer is warming up; not degraded)
Case A: a new feed_populated=false field appears in the payload
Case C: unchanged (ok=true via the new otel_disabled short-circuit; feed_populated unchanged semantically since no producer was ever configured)

case_a_otel_running_empty_feed.description: OtelTraceIngester is alive and polling (cycles_total=1, errors_total=1) but the hot_store has no trace rows yet. Pre-change formula reports ok=False even though the producer is alive.

computed_intermediates.local_traces_ok_pre_change: 0 > 0 OR NOT True OR NOT True = False OR False OR False = False

case_b_otel_running_with_data.description: OtelTraceIngester is alive and has populated hot_store with 100 trace rows. Pre-change formula reports ok=True via the local_traces_count>0 short-circuit.

computed_intermediates.local_traces_ok_pre_change: 100 > 0 OR NOT True OR NOT True = True OR False OR False = True

case_c_otel_skipped_via_env.description: AKOSHA_SKIP_OTEL_INGESTER=1 — OtelTraceIngester was never constructed. No kg_refresh task either. Pre-change formula reports ok=True via the 'not any_producer_ever_cycled' and 'not any_producer_alive' clauses (both producers absent = no degradation possible).

computed_intermediates.local_traces_ok_pre_change: 0 > 0 OR NOT False OR NOT False = False OR True OR True = True
